name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension for BPL elderly citizens aged 60 and above under the National Social Assistance Programme.

benefit.amount: ₹200–₹500/month (Central contribution; states may add more)

documents: BPL ration card or SECC listing
how_to_apply: Visit your local Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body office
Fill the NSAP application form
Submit to Block Development Officer

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (Ayushman Bharat)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Health insurance cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals.

benefit.amount: ₹5,00,000/year per family

conditions: Must be listed in SECC 2011 database OR belong to specified occupational categories

how_to_apply: Check eligibility at mera.pmjay.gov.in
Visit nearest Common Service Centre or empanelled hospital
Get Ayushman card issued on-spot

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Income support of ₹6,000/year in three equal instalments to small and marginal farmer families.

benefit.amount: ₹6,000/year (₹2,000 per instalment)

conditions: Must own cultivable land as per land records
Income-tax payers not eligible
Government employees not eligible

how_to_apply: Register at pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for senior citizens providing 7.4% per annum return on a lump-sum investment, administered by LIC of India.

benefit.amount: ₹1,000–₹9,250/month depending on investment (max purchase ₹15 lakh)

how_to_apply: Note: PMVVY closed for new subscriptions on 31 March 2023; existing policyholders can manage policies at LIC branches
For current senior citizen pension options, explore SCSS or NPS at any bank or post office

name: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme
description: Government-backed savings scheme for senior citizens offering higher interest rates (currently ~8.2% p.a.) with quarterly payouts.

benefit.amount: 8.2% per annum (quarterly payout, subject to revision each quarter)

conditions: Retired defence personnel eligible from age 50

how_to_apply: Visit any authorised bank branch or post office
Fill SCSS account opening form

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension for BPL widows aged 40–79 under the National Social Assistance Programme.

benefit.amount: ₹300/month (Central contribution; states add supplementary amounts)

conditions: Applicant must be a widow

how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body
Submit NSAP application form with widow proof

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension for BPL persons aged 18–79 with severe or multiple disabilities, under NSAP.

benefit.amount: ₹300/month (Central; states add more)

conditions: Must have 80% or more disability or multiple disabilities as certified by government medical board

how_to_apply: Obtain disability certificate from district hospital
Apply at Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of ₹2 lakh at an annual premium of just ₹20.

benefit.amount: ₹2,00,000 (accidental death/full disability) or ₹1,00,000 (partial disability)

how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch or net banking portal
Enroll under PMSBY with auto-debit consent

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death due to any cause, at a premium of ₹436/year.

benefit.amount: ₹2,00,000 (death benefit to nominee)

how_to_apply: Enroll through your bank branch, net banking, or mobile banking

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000/month at age 60, for workers in the unorganised sector.

benefit.amount: ₹1,000–₹5,000/month at age 60 (choice of subscriber)

conditions: Must not be a member of any statutory social security scheme (EPF, NPS, ESIC etc.)
Income tax payers not eligible from May 2022 onwards

how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch or use net banking
Fill APY registration form with nominee details

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Free LPG connection to women from BPL households to replace cooking with solid fuels and improve health outcomes.

benefit.amount: Free LPG connection (cylinder + stove deposit covered by government loan)

conditions: No existing LPG connection in the household

how_to_apply: Visit nearest LPG distributor (IOC / BPCL / HPCL)
Fill PMUY application form (KYC2 form)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin
description: Financial assistance for construction of a pucca house for rural homeless or kutcha-house BPL families.

benefit.amount: ₹1,20,000 (plain areas) or ₹1,30,000 (hilly/north-east/IAP areas)

conditions: Must be listed in SECC 2011 Permanent Wait List (PWL)
Household must be houseless or living in 0–1 room kutcha house

how_to_apply: Check eligibility on awaassoft.nic.in
Contact Block Development Officer if listed but not contacted

name: National Family Benefit Scheme
description: One-time lump-sum assistance to BPL households on the death of a breadwinner aged 18–59.

benefit.amount: ₹20,000 (one-time)

conditions: Deceased breadwinner must have been aged 18–59
Application must be filed within 90 days of death

how_to_apply: Apply within 90 days of death at Gram Panchayat or Block office

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Free or subsidised assistive devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, crutches, artificial limbs, braille kits) for disabled persons with income up to ₹20,000/month.

benefit.amount: Assistive device worth up to ₹16,000 (varies by device category)

conditions: Must have at least 40% disability as certified by government medical authority

how_to_apply: Apply through ALIMCO camps or district office
Register at adip.depwd.gov.in

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Free assistive devices (spectacles, hearing aids, walking sticks, wheelchairs, dentures) for BPL senior citizens with age-related disabilities.

benefit.amount: Assistive devices free of cost (spectacles, hearing aids, wheelchairs, walking sticks, dentures)

conditions: Must have age-related disability (vision, hearing, mobility, dental)

how_to_apply: Register at socialjustice.gov.in or contact district Social Welfare office
Attend designated camp for device distribution

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Credit-linked subsidy and direct benefit for urban poor to own a pucca house. Covers EWS, LIG and MIG categories.

benefit.amount: Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh (EWS/LIG) or ₹2.35 lakh (MIG-I/II) on home loan

conditions: Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
EWS income ≤ ₹3 lakh/year; LIG ₹3–6 lakh; MIG-I ₹6–12 lakh; MIG-II ₹12–18 lakh

how_to_apply: Apply through empanelled banks or housing finance companies
Submit application with income proof and property documents

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: High-interest savings scheme for girl children under age 10, providing 8.2% p.a. interest for education and marriage expenses.

benefit.amount: 8.2% per annum (tax-free interest, subject to revision)
benefit.duration: 21 years from account opening or until girl's marriage after 18

conditions: Account opened for girl child below 10 years of age by parent/guardian

how_to_apply: Visit any post office or authorised bank branch
Fill SSY account opening form
Minimum deposit ₹250/year

name: National Pension System
description: Voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme regulated by PFRDA. Pension corpus at 60; partial withdrawals allowed.

benefit.amount: Market-linked pension corpus at 60; annuity provides regular monthly pension (amount depends on corpus size)

how_to_apply: Register online at enps.nsdl.com or eNPS portal
Or visit Point of Presence (POP) — banks, post offices

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme to generate employment by establishing micro-enterprises in rural and urban areas.

benefit.amount: 15–35% margin money subsidy on project cost (up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing; ₹20 lakh for services)

conditions: Minimum VIII standard pass for projects above ₹10 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹5 lakh (services)

how_to_apply: Apply online at pmegp.msme.gov.in
Submit to nearest KVIC/KVIB/DIC office

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises under three categories: Shishu (≤₹50k), Kishor (₹50k–5L), Tarun (₹5L–10L).

benefit.amount: Up to ₹10,00,000 collateral-free loan (Tarun category); Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishor up to ₹5,00,000
benefit.duration: loan repayment tenure as per bank terms

conditions: Must be a non-farm income-generating micro/small enterprise
No default on any previous loan

how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, MFI, or NBFC
Apply online at mudra.org.in

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for greenfield enterprises.

benefit.amount: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore composite loan (term + working capital)

conditions: Must be SC/ST or woman borrower
Must be setting up a greenfield (new) enterprise in manufacturing, services, or trading

how_to_apply: Apply online at standupmitra.in
Or approach any scheduled commercial bank branch

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
description: Guarantees 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment per year to adult members of rural households willing to do public work.

benefit.amount: ₹267/day (Central wage rate 2024; states may pay more) for up to 100 days/year per household
benefit.duration: 100 days per financial year, ongoing entitlement

conditions: Must be an adult member of a rural household
Willing to do unskilled manual work

how_to_apply: Register at Gram Panchayat to get a Job Card
Apply for work in writing or verbally to Gram Panchayat

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs / Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare
description: Scholarships for dependent wards and widows of ex-servicemen/police personnel for professional degree courses.

benefit.amount: ₹2,500/month (boys) or ₹3,000/month (girls) for 1–5 years depending on course

conditions: Must be dependent ward or widow of ex-serviceman/paramilitary personnel
Must be studying in first year of professional degree (BE, MBBS, MBA, MCA, BEd, BPharm etc.)

how_to_apply: Apply online at ksb.gov.in during the scholarship window (Aug–Nov each year)

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship of ₹12,000/year for meritorious students from economically weaker sections to reduce dropout at Class VIII and encourage study up to Class XII.

conditions: Must have passed Class VIII with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST)
Must be studying in Class IX in a government/aided school
Family income ≤ ₹1.5 lakh/year

how_to_apply: Apply through state government / school
Register on scholarships.gov.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
description: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card, ₹1 lakh accident insurance, ₹30,000 life cover, and overdraft facility up to ₹10,000.

benefit.amount: Zero-balance account + ₹1,00,000 accident insurance + ₹30,000 life cover + ₹10,000 overdraft facility

conditions: Must not already have a bank account (unbanked individual)

documents: Aadhaar card OR any officially valid document (voter ID, driving licence, NREGA card)
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch with KYC documents
Account opened on the spot — no minimum balance required

name: Employees' State Insurance Scheme
description: Medical, sickness, maternity, disablement, and dependent benefits for workers in organised sector establishments with wages up to ₹21,000/month.

benefit.amount: Full medical care for insured person and family at ESI hospitals; cash benefits during sickness (70% of wages), maternity (26 weeks full wages), disablement (90% of wages)

conditions: Must be an employee in an ESIC-covered establishment (10+ workers)
Wage ≤ ₹21,000/month (₹25,000 for persons with disability)

how_to_apply: Employer registers on esic.gov.in and enrols employees
ESIC Pehchan card issued to insured person

name: Employees' Pension Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment / EPFO
description: Monthly pension for EPFO members on superannuation, early retirement, disablement, or to family on death. Minimum pension ₹1,000/month.

benefit.amount: Minimum ₹1,000/month; actual amount based on pensionable salary and service years (formula-based)
benefit.duration: lifetime; family pension continues to widow/widower

conditions: Must have at least 10 years of pensionable service
Must be a member of EPFO

how_to_apply: Submit pension commencement form (Form 10D) to EPFO office through employer
Track at unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in

name: Annapurna Scheme
description: 10 kg free food grain per month for senior citizens aged 65 and above who are eligible but not covered under the National Old Age Pension Scheme.

benefit.amount: 10 kg food grain free per month (rice or wheat as per state allocation)

conditions: Must not be receiving benefit under IGNOAPS
Must be destitute with no regular income or family support

how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat or local food distribution office
Beneficiary identified by state government

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
description: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations above 500 population (250 in hilly/tribal/desert areas).

benefit.amount: All-weather road constructed free of charge to connect village (beneficiary receives road connectivity, not cash)

conditions: Habitation must be unconnected and have population ≥ 500 (or ≥ 250 in special category areas)

how_to_apply: Habitations are identified by state government; no individual application required
Contact Block Development Officer to report unconnected village

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) with safe drinking water at 55 litres per capita per day to every rural household by 2024.

benefit.amount: Tap water connection to household (no cash; infrastructure provided free to BPL/rural households)

conditions: Must be a rural household without an existing functional tap connection

how_to_apply: Register complaint through Gram Panchayat or JJM helpline if your village has no tap connection

name: Central Government Health Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Comprehensive healthcare for Central Government employees, pensioners and their dependents through CGHS wellness centres and empanelled hospitals in covered cities.

benefit.amount: Cashless OPD, IPD, specialist consultations, medicines at CGHS rates in covered cities; ₹30,000–5 lakh reimbursement cap depending on category

conditions: Must be serving/retired Central Government employee, judge, MP, freedom fighter, or accredited journalist in a CGHS-covered city

how_to_apply: Apply through your department's admin section or nearest CGHS zonal office
Pensioners apply at cghs.nic.in

name: Swachh Bharat Mission – Individual Household Latrine
description: One-time financial incentive of ₹12,000 to BPL/APL (below ₹1 lakh income) households for construction of a toilet.

benefit.amount: ₹12,000 (incentive paid after toilet construction and use is verified)

conditions: Household must not already have a toilet
Prioritised for BPL, SC/ST, small/marginal farmers, women-headed households

documents: BPL/APL ration card or income certificate
how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat
Construct toilet first; incentive paid on verification by Swachhagrahis

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage due to unforeseen natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

benefit.amount: Full sum insured equal to scale of finance per hectare; premium capped at 2% (kharif), 1.5% (rabi), 5% (commercial/horticultural crops) for farmers

conditions: Must be a farmer with insurable interest in the notified crop in a notified area
Mandatory for loanee farmers; voluntary for non-loanee farmers

how_to_apply: Apply through nearest bank branch, CSC, or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off date for the season

name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Short-term credit at subsidised interest rates (4–7% p.a. with interest subvention) to farmers for agricultural and allied activities, consumption needs, and maintenance of farm assets.

benefit.amount: Credit limit based on land holding and crop pattern; interest at 4% p.a. (with 3% prompt-repayment subvention on loans up to ₹3 lakh)

conditions: Must be a farmer — individual or joint borrower, tenant farmer, oral lessee, or share-cropper
SHGs and JLGs of farmers also eligible

how_to_apply: Apply at any nationalised bank, cooperative bank, or RRB branch
Also available online at respective bank portals

name: SVAMITVA Scheme
description: Survey of villages and mapping with improvised technology for determining property rights. Issues property cards to residents of inhabited land in rural areas (Abadi land), enabling them to use property as a financial asset.

benefit.amount: Legal property card (Rights of Record) for residential land in rural abadi area, enabling bank loans against property

conditions: Must be resident of rural abadi (inhabited village land)
Village must be covered under the SVAMITVA survey drone mapping

how_to_apply: No individual application needed — state Revenue department and Panchayati Raj carry out village survey
Property card delivered via SMS link to download or at Gram Panchayat

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Free short-term skill training and certification under National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) with monetary reward on certification, to improve employability of Indian youth.

benefit.amount: Free skill training (up to 3 months) + ₹500–₹8,000 monetary reward on assessment pass + placement support

conditions: Must be an Indian national who is school/college dropout OR unemployed/underemployed

how_to_apply: Register at pmkvyofficial.org or visit a PMKVY Training Centre (TC)
Select a NSQF-aligned course and enroll

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Stipend support scheme where the government shares 25% of prescribed stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) with employers engaging apprentices under the Apprentices Act.

benefit.amount: Government shares 25% of stipend subject to maximum ₹1,500/month per apprentice

conditions: Must be engaged as an apprentice under the Apprentices Act 1961 with a registered establishment

how_to_apply: Register as apprentice on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
Apply to registered establishments for apprenticeship openings

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
description: Placement-linked skill training for rural youth from poor families, ensuring a minimum wage job after training. Targets youth aged 15–35 from rural BPL households.

benefit.amount: Free residential/non-residential skill training + placement in jobs paying minimum ₹6,000/month
benefit.duration: training duration 3–12 months; placement support up to 1 year

conditions: Must be from a rural household listed in SECC 2011
Must be willing to relocate for placement if required

how_to_apply: Contact nearest District Programme Coordinator (DPC) under DRDA
Apply through ddugky.gov.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Wi-Fi Access Network Interface
description: Framework for proliferation of broadband through public Wi-Fi hotspots by local entrepreneurs (PDOs) without requiring a licence, to democratise internet access.

benefit.amount: Affordable public Wi-Fi access; PDO providers earn revenue from hotspot usage

conditions: Any individual/entity can become a Public Data Office (PDO) to set up hotspots without licence

how_to_apply: Register as Public Data Office (PDO) at pmwani.gov.in
Citizens use hotspot without registration

name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Free digital literacy training for rural households — covering internet use, digital payments, email, and government services — targeting one person per eligible rural household.

benefit.amount: Free 20-hour digital literacy training with certificate; no monetary payment

conditions: Must be from a rural household where no member has basic digital literacy
SC/ST, BPL, women, differently-abled, and minorities given priority
Note: Training officially concluded on 31 March 2024; scheme may not be accepting new enrollments — verify current status at the helpline

how_to_apply: Register at pmgdisha.in or through nearest CSC (Common Service Centre)
Note: The scheme concluded on 31 March 2024; contact nearest CSC or MeitY for successor digital literacy programs

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission
description: Organises rural poor women into Self Help Groups (SHGs) providing bank credit linkage, skill training, and livelihoods support to reduce poverty.

benefit.amount: Revolving fund of ₹10,000–₹15,000 per SHG; bank credit linkage up to ₹3 lakh (CCL) at 7% interest with interest subvention; skill and livelihood support

conditions: Must be a woman from a rural BPL or vulnerable household
Must be willing to form or join a Self Help Group

documents: BPL listing or vulnerable household proof
how_to_apply: Contact nearest Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) or Gram Panchayat
State Rural Livelihoods Mission (SRLM) facilitates SHG formation

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Multi-sectoral programme to address declining Child Sex Ratio (CSR) and promote education and empowerment of the girl child, with awareness drives and convergent action across education, health, and social sectors.

benefit.amount: Awareness, conditional incentive payments, and access-linked support for girl child registration, immunisation, and school enrolment (amounts vary by state)

conditions: Targeted at girl children and their families; specific incentives vary by state and district

how_to_apply: Contact nearest Anganwadi centre, government school, or district Women and Child Development office

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentives of ₹5,000 in three instalments to pregnant and lactating mothers for the first living child, to compensate for wage loss and improve health and nutrition.

benefit.amount: ₹5,000 in three instalments (₹1,000 + ₹2,000 + ₹2,000) for first child; ₹6,000 for second child if female

conditions: Must be pregnant with first or second living child (second child benefit only if girl)
Excludes central and state government employees receiving similar benefits

documents: MCP card (Mother and Child Protection card)
how_to_apply: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre or approved health facility
Submit PMMVY form within 150 days of last menstrual period for first instalment

name: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation Loan Schemes
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Concessional term loans for income-generating activities to SC individuals below double the poverty line, channelled through State Channelising Agencies (SCAs).

benefit.amount: Term loan at 6% p.a. (up to ₹10 lakh) or 5% p.a. (up to ₹1 crore for Mahila Samridhi Yojana); Micro Credit up to ₹50,000 at 1% p.a. for SC women

conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Caste
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000 (urban) or ₹2,50,000 (rural) — double the poverty line

how_to_apply: Apply through State Channelising Agency (SCA) — typically the State SC Finance Corporation
Details at nsfdc.nic.in

name: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation Loan Schemes
description: Concessional loans and grants for economic development of Scheduled Tribe individuals through State Channelising Agencies, including Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana for ST women.

benefit.amount: Loan at 6% p.a. up to ₹10 lakh; micro credit at 4% p.a. up to ₹1 lakh for ST women

conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe
Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000 (urban) or ₹2,50,000 (rural)

how_to_apply: Apply through State Channelising Agency (State Tribal Finance Corporation)
Details at nstfdc.nic.in

name: Pradhan Mantri DAKSH Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Free skill training programme for marginalised communities — SC, OBC, EBC, sanitation workers, and de-notified tribes — with stipend during training and placement support.

benefit.amount: Free skill training + ₹1,000–₹1,500/month stipend during training + placement assistance
benefit.duration: short-term (1–3 months) or long-term (up to 1 year) course

conditions: Must belong to SC, OBC (with income ≤ ₹3 lakh/year for non-creamy layer), EBC (income ≤ ₹1 lakh/year), sanitation worker, or de-notified tribe

how_to_apply: Register at pmdaksh.dosje.gov.in
Select training course and Training Partner (TP)

name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Dedicated geriatric healthcare programme providing free outpatient and inpatient geriatric services through District Hospitals, Regional Geriatric Centres, and Dedicated Geriatric Wards at Medical Colleges.

benefit.amount: Free OPD, IPD, specialist geriatric consultation, medicines, and day-care services at empanelled government hospitals

how_to_apply: Visit the nearest District Hospital or government medical college with geriatric department
Show age proof at the OPD counter

name: Indian Railways Senior Citizen Concession
description: Concessional railway fares for senior citizens: 40% discount for male passengers aged 60+ and 50% discount for female passengers aged 58+ on all classes and trains.

benefit.amount: 40% fare discount (men aged 60+) or 50% fare discount (women aged 58+) on Indian Railways tickets

conditions: Male passengers must be aged 60 or above; female passengers must be aged 58 or above

documents: Valid age proof (Aadhaar, voter ID, passport, or birth certificate)
how_to_apply: Select 'Senior Citizen concession' while booking ticket on IRCTC or at railway counter
Carry original age-proof document for verification during travel

name: PM Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Campaign to create a barrier-free and accessible India for persons with disabilities, covering built environment, transport, and ICT ecosystem with universal accessibility standards.

benefit.amount: Accessibility retrofitting of government buildings, transport, and websites; no direct cash payment to individuals

conditions: Benefit is infrastructure/accessibility improvement for persons with disabilities; UDID registration preferred for individual access tracking

how_to_apply: Register for UDID at swavlambancard.gov.in
No separate application required; accessibility improvements are systematic

name: Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Post-matriculation scholarship for OBC students pursuing studies beyond Class X at recognised institutions, covering maintenance allowance and reimbursement of compulsory fees.

benefit.amount: ₹230–₹1,200/month maintenance allowance depending on course and residence type + compulsory non-refundable fee reimbursement

conditions: Must belong to Other Backward Class (OBC)
Annual parental/guardian income must not exceed ₹3,00,000 per year
Must be studying at post-matriculation level at a recognised institution

how_to_apply: Apply online at scholarships.gov.in (National Scholarship Portal) during the annual window (typically July–October)

name: National Trust – Supported Independent Living and Community Care
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Schemes under the National Trust for Welfare of Persons with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental Retardation and Multiple Disabilities providing day-care, residential care, caregiver training, and legal guardianship.

benefit.amount: Day-care, residential, and support services at subsidised or free rates through registered organisations; Niramaya health insurance ₹1 lakh/year at ₹250–₹500 premium

conditions: Person must have one of the four disabilities covered: autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation, or multiple disabilities
Must register with the National Trust through a registered local-level organisation (RLO)

documents: Disability certificate from government medical authority
how_to_apply: Contact a Registered Local Level Organisation (RLO) under the National Trust in your district
Apply at thenationaltrust.gov.in

name: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (Senior Citizen 70+)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Extended Ayushman Bharat health cover of ₹5 lakh per year for all senior citizens aged 70 and above, regardless of existing coverage, introduced in 2024.

benefit.amount: ₹5,00,000/year per senior citizen (additional top-up over any existing PMJAY family cover)

how_to_apply: Enroll at mera.pmjay.gov.in by providing Aadhaar and mobile OTP
Or visit nearest Common Service Centre or empanelled hospital for Ayushman card
